name: Adıyaman

routes.outcome: Official TKGM page identifies Parsel Sorgu as a public cadastral parcel service and describes parcel location/basic attributes.

Official Adıyaman municipal map page loaded; HTML exposes a TKGM map layer and municipal parcel/address search UI. Local municipal viewer was evidenced, but no independent public parcel geometry API response was retained from it.
Official TKGM viewer loaded. Current JavaScript configuration exposed the public API host https://cbsapi.tkgm.gov.tr/megsiswebapi.v3.1/api/.
Exact WUP point query returned 'Parsel Bulunamadı'. This is an exact-point miss only and is not evidence of citywide absence.

Bounded nearby anonymous coordinate query returned one GeoJSON Polygon. Response properties included native administrative context and ada/parsel identity; only the stable composite identity Eskisaray-208/2 and unchanged polygon geometry were retained.
Official API administrative-list endpoint returned a GeoJSON feature collection; used to verify the API schema family, not retained as parcel data.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Response geometry coordinates are GeoJSON longitude/latitude; the API viewer uses WGS84-style map coordinates. No reprojection was applied.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: Composite native identity from mahalleAd + adaNo + parselNo: Eskisaray-208/2. No synthetic row number was used.

sourceFieldMapping.mahalleAd: native neighborhood name used in composite identity
sourceFieldMapping.adaNo: native block/ada number used in composite identity
sourceFieldMapping.parselNo: native parcel number used in composite identity

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: one nearby coordinate query, public GET, no authentication, default safe response

localCustodianAssessment: Adıyaman Belediyesi provides a local public map viewer with a TKGM layer and parcel-search UI. The verified geometry response came from TKGM's national public cadastral API, not a separately verified municipal parcel endpoint; national agency prose is not treated as local service evidence.

qualification.reason: Public official parcel API and one safe bounded sample are evidenced; adapter qualification remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted.
The exact-point 404 is a point miss only, not a citywide absence determination.
The retained polygon came from a nearby bounded query and demonstrates service reachability, not citywide completeness or temporal currency.
Only one full polygon is retained; unchanged response evidence remains under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.
uncertainty: Anonymous service reachability, response schema, and one nearby polygon are verified. Coverage, update cadence, licensing beyond the public service, exact-point parcel boundary semantics, and adapter/runtime behavior remain for serial review.
